sloka: स घोषवद्भिश्च हयैः सनागैः ।पुरस्सरैः स्वस्तिकसूतमागधैः ।महीयमानः प्रवरैः च वादकैः ।अभिष्टुतः वैश्रवणो यथा ययौ॥२-१६-४६॥
transliteration: sa ghoṣavadbhiśca hayaiḥ sanāgaiḥ ।purassaraiḥ svastikasūtamāgadhaiḥ ।mahīyamānaḥ pravaraiḥ ca vādakaiḥ ।abhiṣṭutaḥ vaiśravaṇo yathā yayau॥2-16-46॥

translations.english: If this Rama obtains the entire kingdom for a long time, it will be in the interest of the people. If he becomes king none will ever witness anything unpleasant or sad. (They observed).
